line_items.work_text: Sensitization meetings/ IEC materials/Audio Visual/ Advertisement etc.
Updation of District Disaster Management Plan

State level Workshop / Conference on: i) State Disaster Resource Network (SDRN) ii) Workshop on Application of GIS Mapping of Utilities iii)Workshop on preparation of Departmental Disaster Management Plan iv) Three-day Workshop on Post Disaster Needs Assessment

narrative: SEC approved the issue of sanction of an amount of Rs.500.00 lakh under Capacity Building Grant of 13th Finance Commission to ASDMA for the year 2013-14 by Revenue & Disaster Management Department. Post Facto approval was accorded for outsourcing of H.R.Manager for ASDMA. SEC directed ASDMA to float an EOI for part time consultant for disaster management initiatives in Hospitals. SEC approved the proposal for providing HR Support through 4 Nos of outsourced personnel to Kamrup Metro and Golaghat District Disaster Response & Information Centre.
